title: Vortex Yoga Hiking In Sedona
specs: Rated #1 Sedona activity on Trip Advisor 12 years straight
Favorite locations include Teacup, Cathedral Rock, Chapel Trail, Jim Thompson Trail, Thunder Mountain, Little Horse/Chicken Point, Soldiers Pass, and secret sacred locations
Most participants are beginner to intermediate yoga level; no experience required
Dogs allowed if on leash, non-disruptive, and approved by group
Small groups daily with max 7 participants; large private groups up to 18 participants

blurb: Guests participate in outdoor yoga hiking adventures in Sedona's red rock vortex sites. The experience includes a mix of energizing yoga flow, chill-out floor work, and QiGong. Tours are personalized and guided in small groups with a maximum of 7 participants, or up to 18 for large private groups.
extraNote: Cancellation policy: Somehow it always works out for all parties · Mostly at trailhead parking lots with Forest Service Permit allowing access to epic vortex locations. · All year round
